annotations.title: Create a new EduBase user account with a username, name, email address and optional details (group, language, timezone, custom fields, etc

description: Create a new EduBase user account with a username, name, email address and optional details (group, language, timezone, custom fields, etc.). A random initial password is generated if none is given. Returns the user identification string, and the username and password for non-exam accounts.

custom.description: custom field data, keyed by field name (sent as `custom_{field}`), only if the specified field is configured for the target EduBase instance

exam.description: user is only allowed to login when accessing exams (default: false)

language.description: desired account language (default: API application owner's language)

must_change_password.description: user is forced to change password on first login (default: false)

notify.description: notify user via email (or SMS) (default: false)

password.description: password (4-64 characters) (default: initial random password is automatically generated)

phone.description: valid phone number in format "+prefix number" without special characters

template.description: a template ID for the new account (default: none)

timezone.description: desired timezone (default: API application owner's timezone)

name: edubase_post_user
